title: Booking and Mobile Service Schedule for Auto Glass Services
content:
For each **Auto Glass Services** tier, the scheduling desk of Crestline Collision & Glass works from the booking figures below: how far ahead an appointment may and must be set, whether same-day and mobile service are offered, the mobile radius and arrival window, the technician time booked, the lowest forecast temperature for a mobile job, the glass ordering lead time and whether the customer may wait at the center.

### Entries as defined

| Entry | Definition |
|---|---|
| Minimum booking lead | Minimum hours between booking and appointment start, covering glass ordering (integer, hours). |
| Booking horizon | Furthest ahead an appointment may be booked (calendar days). |
| Same-day booking | Whether a same-day appointment may be booked (boolean). |
| Mobile service | Whether the job may be done at the customer's location (boolean). |
| Mobile radius | Distance from the assigned center within which mobile service is offered (miles; 0 means none). |
| Arrival window | Length of the mobile arrival window (hours). |
| Technician time | Technician time booked for the job (minutes). |
| Lowest mobile temperature | Lowest forecast temperature at which a mobile job is performed (degrees Fahrenheit). |
| Glass ordering lead | Business days to receive the glass from the distributor (integer; 0 means no glass ordered). |
| Waiting at the center | Whether the customer may wait at the center during the job (boolean). |

### Lead time, horizon and same-day booking

| Tier | Minimum booking lead (hours) | Booking horizon (calendar days) | Same-day booking | Glass ordering lead (business days) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Windshield Chip Repair | 2 | 14 | Yes | 0 |
| Side Glass Replacement | 4 | 21 | Yes | 1 |
| Rear Glass Replacement | 24 | 21 | No | 2 |
| Windshield Replacement | 4 | 21 | Yes | 1 |
| Camera-Equipped Windshield Replacement | 24 | 21 | No | 2 |
| Premium Feature Windshield Replacement | 48 | 30 | No | 4 |

### Mobile service, arrival window and technician time

| Tier | Mobile service | Mobile radius (miles) | Arrival window (hours) | Technician time (minutes) | Lowest mobile temperature (°F) | Waiting at the center |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Windshield Chip Repair | Yes | 30 | 4 | 30 | 40 | Yes |
| Side Glass Replacement | Yes | 30 | 4 | 60 | 32 | Yes |
| Rear Glass Replacement | Yes | 30 | 4 | 90 | 40 | Yes |
| Windshield Replacement | Yes | 30 | 4 | 90 | 40 | Yes |
| Camera-Equipped Windshield Replacement | Yes | 20 | 4 | 120 | 40 | Yes |
| Premium Feature Windshield Replacement | No | 0 | 4 | 150 | 40 | Yes |

### Points read from the schedule

- Windshield Chip Repair orders no glass (glass ordering lead 0) and carries the shortest minimum booking lead, 2 hours.
- Same-day booking is open on Windshield Chip Repair, Side Glass Replacement and Windshield Replacement, and closed on Rear Glass Replacement, Camera-Equipped Windshield Replacement and Premium Feature Windshield Replacement.
- Premium Feature Windshield Replacement is not offered as mobile service; its mobile radius is 0, meaning none. Camera-Equipped Windshield Replacement offers mobile service within 20 miles of the assigned center, and the other four tiers within 30 miles.
- Every tier's mobile arrival window is 4 hours.
- Side Glass Replacement is the one tier whose lowest mobile temperature is 32 °F; every other tier's is 40 °F.
- The customer may wait at the center on every tier.

*Hypothetical illustration:* a Windshield Replacement job booked on a Monday may take an appointment as early as 4 hours after the booking, the same day included, and as late as 21 calendar days ahead; a Premium Feature Windshield Replacement job booked at the same moment needs at least 48 hours of lead and may be set up to 30 calendar days ahead, at a center rather than at the customer's location.
